description: Fork of exp050 (E=96). Replaces fp32 joint Q/K MultiHeadLut with joint BitMultiHeadLUT(n_inputs=E=96, n_heads=H=6, n_outputs=2*P_qk=992, input_nap=5, output_nap=24, tph=512) + CLT scale. Output [B*T, H, 992] split into q_raw=out[:P_qk] and k_raw=out[P_qk:] per head, then both passed through DominanceCanonicalize(d_qk=32) to canonicalise pair-dominance before SDPA. All projections now bit-LUT, consistent with V/out_proj. Q/K bit budget = 14.2M bits ≈ 1.77 MB (vs exp050's 151 MB fp32).
